research_question: Does task-conditioned repository context selected by the future P2 context engine improve verified task success over bounded textual retrieval on the same frozen tasks without unacceptable safety, latency, or cost regression?
falsifiable_hypothesis: On a Founder-approved P2 dataset that is frozen before execution, A0 task-conditioned context selection will improve run-level VTSR over the B1 simple-retrieval baseline by at least 0.10 absolute while unsafe-action rate remains zero and median latency and available cost each increase by no more than 25 percent.
minimum_report: raw numerator denominator failures and invalids
available cost and unavailable metering count
stop_conditions: P2 entry is not explicitly authorized
the dataset, model, environment, evaluator, budget or primary metric is not frozen before execution
the practical VTSR threshold is not reached within the frozen budget
latency or available cost exceeds its practical guardrail
evidence is incomplete, contaminated or not reproducible
